Mission.name: Quarry Heavy Machinery Haul
Mission.summary: Recover a parked heavy-machinery trailer at the port and tow it up to the Grand Senora quarry.
Mission.description: A heavy-machinery lowboy has been staged down at the docks and needs to reach the quarry yard intact. Bring your own road tractor, hook the armytrailer2, deliver it into the quarry drop zone, then clear the area so yard crews can take possession.
